claude_proposed_widenings.name: emit_light
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: On hit, the target emits Dim Light in a 10-foot radius until the end of the caster's next turn. No v4 atom covers a timed light-emission effect applied to a creature as an on-hit consequence. The closest candidates (grant_sense, apply_condition) do not capture light emission from a target creature.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: until the end of your next turn, it emits Dim Light in a 10-foot radius

claude_proposed_widenings.name: deny_condition_benefit
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: On hit, the target can't benefit from the Invisible condition until the end of the caster's next turn. This is not removing the condition (remove_condition) nor applying a new one (apply_condition). It suppresses the mechanical benefit of an existing condition without stripping it. No v4 atom represents this operation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: can't benefit from the Invisible condition
